messages.text:
Here is where each of your three orders stands.

**Brass desk lamp (order h403-o2):** I've made a refund proposal of 86.90 BRL. Please confirm it with the button on the proposal card. A staff member then reviews it (refund-policy/v2/approval). The refund is the amount you paid for that unit (refund-policy/v2/amount). The lamp's records show 86.90 BRL paid, so that's the amount I can offer. If you saw a higher listed price, the difference is probably a discount share on your order. The policy sets each unit's refund as its price minus its share of any discount. I can't see the listed price from here, so I can't confirm that.

**Velvet throw pillow (order h403-o1):** I can't refund this one. The shop's records show it was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). The refund deadline was 2026-11-11 10:00 UTC, and it has passed. Refunds must be requested within 30 days of delivery (refund-policy/v2/window).

**Acrylic monitor stand (order h403-o3):** This order's status is "shipped", not delivered. Only delivered orders can be refunded (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders). Cancelling the order or changing its delivery is outside this process. I can offer a staff member for that if you'd like.
